skills.name: Example Skill
skills.description: A template showing how to structure a tribe skill with metadata, labels, and clear documentation.

skills.name: Figma Design System Sync
skills.description: Sync design tokens and component properties from a Figma file to a Moose WordPress theme codebase. Extracts colors, typography, spacing, layout, buttons, and border radius with full variable mode support.

skills.name: Git Workflow Standards
skills.description: Git branch naming conventions and pull request standards. Use when creating branches, making commits, opening pull requests, or when the user asks about git workflow conventions.

skills.name: Jira Testing Instructions
skills.description: Adds precise QA and UAT testing instructions to Jira tickets using implementation-aware context. Use when the user specifically asks to add testing instructions while working a Jira ticket.

skills.name: Jira Ticket Standard
skills.description: Creates and updates Jira tickets using the team's standard structure and language. Use when the user asks to create a Jira ticket, rewrite ticket descriptions, or standardize Goals/Outcomes/Assets formatting.

skills.name: ModernPress Coding Standards
skills.description: Apply ModernPress WordPress PHP coding standards for core plugin and theme work, including Modern Tribe PHPCS, blocks, CPTs, query hooks, and integrations.

skills.name: ModernPress Figma Sync
skills.description: Syncs the codebase (CSS variables, theme.json, and PostCSS files) to match Figma design tokens and styles. Use whenever a user asks about syncing, updating, or pulling from a Figma design.

skills.name: Package Change Approval
skills.description: Require explicit user approval before installing unrequested packages or updating dependencies with any package manager. Use when considering Composer, npm, Yarn, pnpm, Bun, pip, Poetry, Cargo, Go modules, Bundler, Maven/Gradle, or similar dependency changes.

skills.name: Port to ModernPress
skills.description: Backports code improvements, features, or bug fixes discovered during a client project back to the ModernPress WordPress starter framework. Handles repo discovery, branching, applying changes, build verification, committing, and PR creation.

skills.name: Promote Skill
skills.description: Promotes a new skill or updates an existing skill in the tribe-skills repo from another local project, including branching, diff review, version bumping, validation, commit, PR creation, and reinstall reminder.

skills.name: Review Release
skills.description: Review a software release by cross-referencing a Jira release with a GitHub pull request to verify scope alignment. Use when the user asks to review a release, audit a release PR, check if a PR matches a Jira release, verify release scope, or compare Jira tickets against PR commits.

skills.name: Ticket Autopilot
skills.description: Executes one or more Jira tickets end-to-end with minimal supervision.

skills.name: Update Frontend Dependencies
skills.description: Review and methodically upgrade frontend dependencies managed in package.json across projects.
